description: Code, data and results for a Monte Carlo study of choosing an estimator of the typical level (mean, median, trimmed mean, Huber and Hodges–Lehmann estimators) with a random forest and a two-condition rule, compared with Hogg's adaptive rule, and applied to five Rosstat regional indicators for 2025.
